REVIEW PACKETS FOR AGENT-AUTHORED CHANGES

Review agent-authored changes before merge

For small software teams that need a required owner and test evidence before an agent-authored change lands.

Try it with sample data
Opens a complete review packet.
Sample data stays in this browser.
Signed-in teams see only their review packets.
Export the sample packet as JSON.
CHECK

REVIEW PACKET

Review a pull request

TEAM REVIEW

Sign in before reviewing repository changes

Sociobot Entra identifies the reviewer. Packets are visible only to that reviewer’s team.

Sign in with Sociobot

HOW IT WORKS

How review packets work
Sign in.
Start a team review workspace.
Set repository policy.
Name sensitive paths and the required owner.
Record evidence.
Save test evidence before the required owner approves.
What Diff Gate does not do

Diff Gate records a review decision. Your team merges code outside Diff Gate.

Review agent-authored changes before merge.
